_doc: The plastic worker's per-texture overrides (layout as tools/materials/overrides.json).
Lens and film atlases: a=0 (no moulding grain) and wear=0 (no scuffs), so tinted or clear lenses stay smooth;
the frames keep the clear-coat sheen. Non-plastic members: the frontend dial marker is UI art (strength 0),
the banana bomb is a smooth waxy peel, the blaster base a satin moulding.
